facts.text: KeithleyDMM6500 is a 6.5-digit multimeter; the class uses the SCPI command set to communicate with the instrument
voltage is the ':READ?' measurement in volts of the active measurement mode
measure_voltage() switches the mode to DC voltage, or AC voltage with ac=True, and sets the voltage range
current is the ':READ?' measurement in amperes of the active measurement mode
measure_current() switches the mode to DC current, or AC current with ac=True, and sets the current range
The DC current full-scale ranges are 10e-6 to 10 A (10 A only on the rear terminals)
measure_resistance() selects 2-wire resistance with wires=2 or 4-wire resistance with wires=4 and sets the range; any other value raises ValueError
temperature is the ':READ?' measurement in degrees Celsius of the active measurement mode
The NPLC integration time of the active mode is validated as a truncated range with values=[0.0005, 15]
The number of display digits of the active mode is validated as one of 3, 4, 5, 6
scan_stop() aborts a scanning measurement by writing :ABOR, stopping the measurement arming and triggering sequence
